prepare_graph_module: prepare a GraphModule by inserting observers and fake quantize nodes based on quantization annotations
get_edge_or_node_to_qspec: get a map from EdgeOrNode to quantization spec based on node quantization annotations
get_edge_or_node_to_group_id: compute group IDs for EdgeOrNode using union-find to handle SharedQuantizationSpec and implicit sharing
get_obs_or_fq_map: generate a map from EdgeOrNode to observer or fake quantize instances grouped by shared group ID
insert_input_output_observers: insert input and output observers for each node in a quantized GraphModule graph
